about: Access decisions at the effect boundary (the app proxy): which request reaches an app's container, as whom and with which rank. Each case names a fixture (the box's access state file text, null when absent, the account people it knows and the owner's account id), the app the ROUTER selected (never the Host header), and the request: method, raw path, upgrade, the origin headers, the session cookie's record (live = present, unexpired, not closed), the API key check's result and whether external access is fresh (N07). outcome: forward | deny | api-invalid (401) | api-scope (403) | api-rate-limited (429). For forward: visitor member|api|anonymous, role (null when anonymous), identity (the key the app id is derived from: the owner's account id for every account device; null when anonymous), external (the visitor is outside the owner's own devices). TypeScript: packages/server-daemon/tests/accessEnforcementVectors.test.ts; Rust: rust/crates/flagship-access/tests/decision_vectors.rs.
